translation_snapshot.source: This mindstar oozes a thick, caustic liquid. Magic seems to die around it.
translation_snapshot.target: 这只灵晶在不断的向外渗出粘糊糊的液体。魔法似乎消逝在它周围。

translation_snapshot.source: This crystalline structure seems to be filled with a malevolent aura. Through the crystal surface you can still see the remains of what once was a huge tree.
translation_snapshot.target: 这个水晶一样的生物内部似乎充满了邪恶能量，透过水晶表面，你似乎还能看到里面曾是树的部分。

translation_snapshot.source: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#The powerful darkness aura you felt wanes away.
translation_snapshot.target: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#你感受到身边的黑暗光环消退了。

translation_snapshot.source:
This mural shows nine Sher'Tul standing side by side, each holding aloft a dark weapon. Your eyes are drawn to a runed staff held by the red-robed figure in the centre. It seems familiar somehow...
There is some text beneath
translation_snapshot.target:
这幅壁画显示了九个夏·图尔人肩并肩站着，每人手里都高举着一件一模一样的黑色武器。你的注意力集中在画面中间——被红袍者举起的符文法杖上。它看起来很眼熟……
下面有一行文字

translation_snapshot.source:
Summon a Minotaur for %d turns to attack your foes. Minotaurs cannot stay summoned for long, but they deal high damage.
		It will get %d Strength, %d Constitution and %d Dexterity.
		Your summons inherit some of your stats: increased damage%%, resistance penetration %%, stun/pin/confusion/blindness resistance, armour penetration.
		The minotaur's Strength and Dexterity will increase with your Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
召唤一只米诺陶来攻击敌人，持续 %d 回合。米诺陶不会呆很长时间，但是它们会造成极大伤害。
		它拥有 %d 点力量，%d 点体质和 %d 点敏捷。
		你的召唤物继承你部分属性：增加百分比伤害、抗性穿透、震慑/定身/混乱/致盲抵抗和护甲穿透。
		米诺陶的力量和敏捷受精神强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: Take a step toward your foes then use the momentum to cleave all creatures adjacent to you for %d%% weapon damage.
translation_snapshot.target: 向前跳一步，用这股力量对周围的目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害。

translation_snapshot.source: You arrived through the farportal in a cave, probably in the Far East.
translation_snapshot.target: 你穿过了山洞的远行传送门，可能会到达远东大陆。

translation_snapshot.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have sided with Slasul and killed Ukllmswwik.#WHITE#
translation_snapshot.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你选择相信萨拉苏尔并杀死了乌克勒姆斯维奇。#WHITE#

translation_snapshot.source:
You gain 25%% absolute damage resistance and 25%% all damage penetration.  Each time you are struck by a weapon these bonuses are reduced by 5%% but fully recovered after 8 turns.
			Additionally, you gain 70%% of the highest of your Magic or Dexterity stat as defense (%d)
translation_snapshot.target:
你获得 25%% 绝对伤害抗性，25%% 全体伤害抗性穿透。
			每当你被武器攻击的时候，这项增益会减少 5%%，8 回合后完全恢复。
			此外，你将获得相当于你魔力和敏捷中最高的一项  70%% 的闪避值 (%d)

translation_snapshot.source: The Sandworm Lair is to the far west of Derth, near the sea.
translation_snapshot.target: 在德斯镇远一点的西面，靠近海岸的地方是沙虫巢穴。

translation_snapshot.source: Claws and teeth. Fire and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
translation_snapshot.target: 尖牙利齿，火焰致命。似乎龙族并没有灭绝……
